headline: Swiss Inflation Accelerates as SNB Signals Concern Over Price Pressures
summary: Swiss consumer price inflation accelerated, prompting the Swiss National Bank to signal concern over broader price pressures. SNB Vice Chairman stated the central bank is closely watching for second-round inflation effects.
why: The Swiss National Bank sets monetary policy for Switzerland, where currency strength and inflation metrics directly influence Swiss franc valuation and European trade.

impacts.name: Swiss Franc
impacts.why: Higher inflation readings and hawkish SNB remarks increase expectations for tighter monetary policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Accelerating CPI figures accompanied by warnings from the SNB raised market expectations of prolonged monetary tightness.
